name: Otanoshimi CD Vol. 2
source:
○ Produced by Nekuromikon "A Day in the Life of a High Orc"

A kind-hearted high orc living in an orc village declares war on humans to protect his villagers!! He punishes girls one after another for the sake of peace.
Peace to the orc village!!

○ Produced by Bishamon "Naked Girl Roku Erotic Picture Scroll"

You can enjoy short stories by selecting girls from various professions. 
Which profession girl do you prefer?

○ All female voices in both games are fully voiced.

[Translated from the [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20060213022559/http://www111.sakura.ne.jp/~game/bisya/freevol2.html] official website[/url]]
